Package index

Functions

The functions needed to train the naive Bayesian classifier and run it on an unknown sequence

build_kmer_database()
Build kmer database
create_database()
Build custom database object for use with phylotypr
classify_sequences()
Classify a vector of 16S rRNA gene sequence fragments
classify_sequence()
Classify 16S rRNA gene sequence fragment
filter_taxonomy()
Filter taxonomy
print_taxonomy()
Print taxonomy for an unknown sequence
read_fasta()
Read in a FASTA-formatted file containing DNA sequences
write_fasta()
Write to a FASTA-formatted file
read_taxonomy()
Read in taxonomy files
phylotypr_example()
Get path to phylotypr example

Example reference sequences and taxonomy that can be used for practicing use of the package’s functions

RDP training set v9
